messages:
Mai: heads-up — looking into the cost dashboard, noticed some routes showing negative marginal cost after cache/prefetch credits applied. anyone else seeing this? :thinking:
Jordan: saw a blip on /chat/complete earlier, looked like prefetch warmups were being credited twice for certain request chains.
Sam: i reproduced locally. root cause seems to be attribution to the first owner + later refund when the cache hit shows up. quick repro command i used:
```
curl -X POST https://staging.api/redwood/econ/sim -d '{"route":"/chat/complete","chain":["A","B"],"prefetch":true}'
```
Anika: UX note — folks are confused that their "unit cost" goes negative in the dashboard. Can we show a clear explanation or toggle to exclude prefetch credits? :eyes:
Mai: proposal: add two parallel columns in the dashboard — "raw token cost" and "adjusted (with cache credits)". default view shows adjusted, with a small badge linking to an explanation. also we should treat canary traffic as excluded from amortized prefetch pools so experiments don't drive negative numbers.
Jordan: i like the two-column approach. question: does this require changing the econ event schema? we currently roll prefetch credits into a single field.
Sam: minimal schema change: attach route_chain_ids + owner_hint to econ.events when prefetch is applied. new fields are optional strings. sample payload example: `{"route":"/chat/complete","token_cost":12,"cache_credit":-15,"route_chain_ids":"A|B","owner_hint":"service-A"}`
Jordan: small worry — adding route_chain_ids increases cardinality and storage. can we sample these high-cardinality tags? maybe 5% for long tails and 100% for canary and paid tiers.
Mai: agree on sampling. plan: deterministic sampling keyed by tenant-id so we always see a consistent slice for debugging. canary traffic gets full fidelity.
Anika: for console UX i can add the toggle (include/exclude cache credits) and an inline tooltip that links to the explanation and a short animation showing how prefetch is amortized. will need a simple API from econ to return both series.
Sam: action items: 1) add optional tags + cache_credit field to econ event (sam) 2) add deterministic sampling (sam/jordan) 3) console toggle + help text (anika) 4) update rollout policy docs to exclude canaries from amortization (mai). I'll open PRs.
Jordan: also let's add an alert for negative 95p marginal cost per-route for >10m to catch regressions early.
Mai: agreed. i'll file a short RFC and a rollout checklist. ping me if blocked. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: econ-service v2.13.4 deployed to staging (hash: c1a2b3f)
Sam: tests passing for the schema change, will open PR for sampling config in ~30m.
Anika: ack, i'll start a small mock for the toggle and post in #design once ready.
Mai: thanks all — meeting in 15 to sync if anyone wants to join.
